rubric_items.reason: Built on existing repo/service/page layering, slotStates and ?date= link; no new infra. OnDutyRow placed in dashboardService.ts while produced by DoctorService, against the shared api/src/types.ts pattern.
Story map covers S-1..S-7; two-block AC5, 04:00 local cases, PAST handling, Fully booked, sort tie-break, Period independence and DSH-9 are all addressed by named components.
Every new EP-1 field has name, type, nullability, format and example, including the UTC/local nextFree.start example; ACs can assert values exactly.
All 22 claims check out against product code and inventory; endpoint shape and nextFree decided by cited IDE answers A-03 and A-04.
Trade-offs given for extending the endpoint, service placement, per-doctor queries and nextFree shape, each with its cost.
Clear, consistent, front matter and body agree.

findings.text: OnDutyRow is declared in dashboardService.ts but built by DoctorService.onDutyToday(), so doctorService imports a type from the service that depends on it; shared API types (NextDay, DoctorSummary) live in api/src/types.ts.

findings.suggested_fix: Declare OnDutyRow in api/src/types.ts next to NextDay and import it in both services.

findings.text: onDutyToday() derives today from its own clock read while the link uses Dashboard.today from lastDays in DashboardService; across local midnight the rows and the ?date= link can name different days.
findings.suggested_fix: Have DashboardService.get() pass its now and today into doctors.onDutyToday(today, now) so one instant drives both.
